audience: SaaS and product teams who send email to their users with Loops

useCases.title: Look up a contact in Loops
useCases.text: The AI finds a contact by email or user id and shows the properties Loops holds for them.

useCases.title: Add or update a contact
useCases.text: The AI creates a contact, or updates one by email or user id. Update also creates the contact if it is not found.

useCases.title: Send a transactional email
useCases.text: The AI sends a transactional email from a Loops template to a recipient. This sends a real email.

useCases.title: Send an event to start automations
useCases.text: The AI sends an event for a contact. Any loop that listens to this event starts.

useCases.title: Check lists, or add a contact property
useCases.text: The AI lists your mailing lists and the contact properties you defined, and can add a new custom property.
